name: n4_neql_query
description: Find components by their tags with a NEQL query (one GET of base_ord|neql:<query>|view:file:ITableToCsv, the documented ORD route). neql is a filter such as n:point, hs:equip and not hs:ahu, tst:label = "hello", hs:temp > 20, n:name like ".*Pump.*" or a relation path (n:parent->hs:floor = 2); implied tags count. It matches the components below base_ord (default station:|slot:/), never base_ord itself, and returns their station ORDs (ords). With bql (one select, e.g. select slotPath, out.value) the station runs that select on the matches and the reply carries its columns and rows instead. '|' is refused (the ORD separator); a query the station cannot parse is HTTP 400, reported as such. max_rows (default 200, at most 2000) bounds the reply; truncated says it was cut.

neql.description: NEQL filter, e.g. hs:point and hs:temp

base_ord.description: Search below this component ORD (default station:|slot:/)

bql.description: Optional select run on the matches, e.g. select slotPath, out.value
